articles.title: The Ukrainian family wiped out by Putin: Ten relatives feared dead in 'evil' Russian strike on home including parents and three children
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky revealed a Russian missile attack tragically wiped out the Voronov family, sharing their photos on social media. This incident underscores the devastating human cost of the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict, emphasizing the direct impact of hostilities on civilian lives and families, a critical aspect for SSB aspirants to understand regarding international security and humanitarian issues.

articles.title: Space ecosystem needs go beyond rocketry: Ex-ISRO chief at Vishwakarma Government Engineering College in Ahmedabad
articles.summary: An ex-ISRO chief, speaking at Vishwakarma Government Engineering College in Ahmedabad, stressed that India's space ecosystem must evolve beyond just rocketry. He emphasized developing diverse applications and industries within the sector, promoting broader innovation and self-reliance. This perspective is vital for SSB aspirants to understand India's technological future and the multi-faceted opportunities in national development.

articles.title: HARVARD DCE DEAN NANCY COLEMAN RECEIVES UPCEA'S HIGHEST HONOR FOR ONLINE LEARNING LEADERSHIP
articles.summary: Nancy Coleman, Dean of Harvard's Division of Continuing Education, was honored with the 2026 Ray Schroeder Leadership Award. This significant recognition occurred at the SOLAR Conference in Boston on July 30, 2026. The award celebrates her impactful leadership and substantial contributions to the field of continuing education, marking her as a prominent figure within the academic community.

articles.title: Drone Strike Near Suez Canal in Egypt Raises New Security Threat in Widening War
articles.summary: A drone strike on gas vessels in Egypt's Mediterranean port of Damietta indicates a potential new front in the U.S.-Iran conflict, escalating regional tensions. This poses significant threats to maritime navigation security in a vital waterway. For SSB aspirants, it highlights evolving proxy warfare and its implications for global shipping lanes and strategic choke points, crucial for security analysis.

articles.title: Priyanka Gandhi's 'gaumutra expert' jibe lands her in trouble, over 200 academicians criticise
articles.summary: Prominent Indian vice chancellors, former vice chancellors, and academicians have collectively written an open letter to Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra. They conveyed "deep disappointment," likely pertaining to recent national developments or policies. This statement from leading educational figures to a prominent opposition leader underscores significant concerns within academic circles regarding governance or societal direction in India.
